tab.description: Papers and notes that give the AI assistant background on this project. Each is read once and kept; the assistant uses its summary, and looks up details when it needs them.
tab.empty: No references yet. Add a paper (a PDF, a link or a DOI) or paste some text, with a note on why it matters.

add.title: Add a reference
add.description: The file, page or text is read once now and kept, so the assistant never has to read it again.
add.fileHint: Up to 20 MB and 150 pages. A scanned PDF with no text cannot be read.
add.urlHint: For example https://example.com/paper or 10.1016/j.apsusc.2020.146190. A page behind a paywall cannot be read: upload the PDF instead.
add.textHint: Paste the passage, abstract or your own notes (up to 300,000 characters).
add.titleHint: Leave empty to use the title of the file or page.
add.notePlaceholder: For example: how the plasma pulse changes the growth per cycle
add.browse: or click to choose a file
add.chosen: Chosen: {name} ({size} MB). Drop or choose another to replace it.

errors.invalid: Check the details and try again.
errors.limitReached: This project already has the most references it can hold ({max}). Delete one first.
errors.fileTooLarge: This file is larger than 20 MB.
errors.notPdf: This does not look like a PDF file.
errors.unreadablePdf: This PDF could not be read. Is it damaged or password protected?
errors.tooManyPages: This PDF has more than 150 pages. Add the part you need instead.
errors.noText: There is not enough text to keep. A scanned PDF has no text: paste the text instead.
errors.linkInvalid: This is not a web address or a DOI.
errors.linkBlocked: This address cannot be read from here: it points inside a private network.
errors.linkFailed: The page could not be read (it did not answer, or refused). Try again, or upload the PDF.
errors.linkTooLarge: This page or file is larger than 10 MB.
errors.linkUnsupported: This link is not a web page, a PDF or plain text.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong while adding the reference.
errors.yearInvalid: Use a four-digit year, such as 2023.
errors.urlInvalid: Use a web address or a DOI.

card.truncated: Only the first part was kept: the length limit was reached.
card.noSummary: No summary yet. The assistant uses your note.

edit.title: Edit reference
edit.description: Change the details, your note or the summary the assistant reads.
edit.summaryHint: The assistant reads this instead of the whole text. Edit it freely.

delete.title: Delete this reference?
delete.description: {title} and the text read from it will be removed. The assistant will no longer know about it.
